data.message: I propose a 10-ton cap per fisher this month and in future months when stock is 500. If all 25 comply, 250 tons remain, guaranteeing restoration to 500 under either replenishment outcome and earning each of us $10,000 monthly indefinitely. I intend to request 10 if discussion supports this plan. Please state whether you support the cap; catches revealed afterward will let us assess compliance.
